meta.document: City of Scottsdale AZ FY2025-26 Adopted Budget
meta.title: Scottsdale — the money trail
meta.note: The City of Scottsdale, Arizona — a council-manager city of ~245,000 in Maricopa County. This is the adopted all-funds budget for FY2025-26, $2.20 billion, shown by fund (adopted Ordinance 4670). Police is the largest General-Fund department — note its FY26 figure includes a one-time ~$50M pension paydown, so the recurring cost is closer to $150M. Scottsdale owns its own water utility. The combined city property-tax rate is $0.9124 per $100 (primary $0.4891 + secondary/bond $0.4233). Every fund figure ties to the adopted state forms and foots to the dollar.

nodes.note: The main operating fund — Police and Fire are most of it. (Includes a large emergency reserve.)
